abilities.name: RETREAT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit. That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units but cannot end that move within an enemy unit’s combat range.

abilities.name: MAGICAL INTERVENTION
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD or PRIEST to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That friendly unit can use a SPELL, PRAYER or BANISH ability (as appropriate) as if it were your hero phase. If you do so, subtract 1 from casting rolls or chanting rolls made as part of that ability.

abilities.name: RALLY
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect:
Make 6 rally rolls of D6. For each 4+, you receive 1 rally point. Rally points can be spent in the following ways:
For each rally point spent, Heal (1) that unit.
You can spend a number of rally points equal to the Health characteristic of that unit to return a slain model to that unit.
You can spend the rally points in any combination of the above. Unspent rally points are then lost.

abilities.name: STANDARD BEARER
abilities.effect: While this unit contains any standard bearers, add 1 to this unit’s control score.

abilities.name: FLY
abilities.effect: As this unit moves, it ignores other models, terrain features and the combat ranges of enemy units. It cannot end its move in combat unless specified in the ability that allowed it to move. Ignore any vertical distance moved for this unit.

abilities.name: WARD SAVE
abilities.effect: In step 1 of the damage sequence (see 18.0), make a ward roll of D6 for each damage point in this unit’s damage pool. If the roll equals or exceeds this unit’s ward value, remove that damage point from the damage pool.

abilities.name: BANISH MANIFESTATION
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD or PRIEST to use this ability, pick a MANIFESTATION within 30" of them that was not summoned this turn to be the target, then make a banishment roll of 2D6. Add 1 to the banishment roll for each additional enemy MANIFESTATION on the battlefield after the first. You cannot pick the same MANIFESTATION to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect: If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on the MANIFESTATION’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play.

abilities.name: SACRED RITES
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly PRIEST to use this ability, then make a chanting roll of D6. On an unmodified chanting roll of 1, remove 1 ritual point from that PRIEST instead of D3.
abilities.effect: Give a number to ritual points to the PRIEST equal to the unmodified chanting roll and do not reset the PRIEST’s ritual points to 0.

abilities.name: POWER THROUGH
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then you must pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. The target must have a lower Health characteristic than the unit using this ability.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, the unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that were in combat with it at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat.

abilities.name: MUSICIAN
abilities.effect: While this unit contains any musicians, if it uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make one additional rally roll of D6.

abilities.name: UNBIND
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: A friendly WIZARD within 30" of the enemy WIZARD casting the spell.
Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, then the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved. This reaction cannot be used more than once per casting roll.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared a SPELL ability

abilities.name: COVERING FIRE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that did not use a RUN ability this turn and that is not in combat to use this ability, then pick the closest enemy unit (to that unit) that can be picked as the target of shooting attacks to be the target. You cannot pick MANIFESTATIONS or faction terrain features as the target of this ability.
abilities.effect: Resolve shooting attacks for the unit using this ability against the target. You must subtract 1 from the hit rolls for those attacks.

abilities.name: ACTIVATE PLACE OF POWER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly HERO within 3" of any Places of Power to use this ability.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on that HERO. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following effects:
Ignite Fury: Gain 2 rage dice, then increase your fury level by 2, to a maximum of 7.
Channel Wrath: If that HERO is a WIZARD or PRIEST, add 1 to casting rolls or chanting rolls for that HERO for the rest of the turn.
Dizzying Rage: For the rest of the turn, if that HERO is not a WIZARD or PRIEST, they can use the ’Unbind’ or ’Banish Manifestation’ ability as if they had WIZARD (1).

abilities.name: THE LIVING CITY CROSS
abilities.effect: While this unit has any champions, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: FIERCE COMPETITION
abilities.effect:
Each time a unit in this Regiment of Renown uses an ability and any enemy models were slain by that ability, after that ability has been resolved, the unit that used that ability is pre-eminent and the other unit in this Regiment of Renown is overlooked.
Weapons used by an overlooked unit in this Regiment of Renown have Crit (Auto-wound).

abilities.name: FIRE AND FLIGHT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit
abilities.effect: After that SHOOT ability has been resolved, this unit can move 2D6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit

abilities.name: FIGHT AND FLIGHT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 12". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: THE HORNS HIT HOME
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly unit that is preparing a flank attack to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up the targets on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of each other, wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: WE’LL BE THERE - IF THE PAY’S RIGHT
abilities.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the targets if none of them have been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up the targets in reserve preparing a flank attack. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: RAVENOUS COUNTER-ATTACK
abilities.effect: Enemy units do not count as having charged while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: SHOCK AND GORE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks.

abilities.name: GLUTTHORN STAMPEDE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is INFANTRY. On a 4+, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Glutthorn’s Horn and Hooves is 5.

abilities.name: PITILESS WARLORD
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for an OGOR MAWTRIBES unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.effect: Re-roll 1 dice in that charge roll.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a CHARGE ability for an OGOR MAWTRIBES unit wholly within 12" of this unit

abilities.name: HIGH STAR’S LIGHT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: SPEED OF THE TWIN-TAILED COMET
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3" to the Move characteristic of friendly non-WAR MACHINE CITIES OF SIGMAR units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: CURSE OF SCORCHED METAL
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the first time the target uses an ATTACK ability, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for an attack made by the target as part of that ATTACK ability, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the ATTACK ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: HOUR OF RETRIBUTION
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by units in this Regiment of Renown.
Add 1 to save rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown.

warscrolls.name: Stormdrake Guard (1 model)
notes: You can include 1 unit of this type for each Knight-Draconis in your army.

abilities.name: EXTREMIS CHAMBER
abilities.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: DISPERSED FORMATION
abilities.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

abilities.name: DRACONIC ONSLAUGHT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. Then, pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. Inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

abilities.name: ARCANE HERITAGE
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.effect: If this unit or a friendly Stormdrake Guard unit wholly within 12" of this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 4+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit or that friendly unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per SPELL ability.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared a SPELL ability

abilities.name: WRATH OF THE DRACONITH
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Stormdrake Guard unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of both this unit’s and the target’s Draconith’s Fangs and Talons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: EXTREMIS CHAMBER
abilities.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: AQSHIAN ORDER OF MERIT
abilities.effect: While this unit has any champions, if an enemy unit in combat with this unit uses the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability, when resolving attacks as part of that ability, on an unmodified hit roll of 6, do not inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on each unit in combat with that unit.

abilities.name: HAVE NO MERCY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of the next battle round, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR AELF units that target that enemy unit while it is damaged or has had any models slain in the same turn.

abilities.name: NAUGHTY OR NICE?
abilities.effect:
If you are the naughty player, friendly units’ melee weapons have Crit (Auto-wound) while they are contesting Da Red Gobbo.
If you are the nice player, friendly units have WARD (6+) while they are contesting Da Red Gobbo

abilities.name: CLANK, CLANK, CLANK
abilities.effect:
Roll 3D6. If Da Red Gobbo is within a number of inches of the exit point equal to the roll, he escapes, the battle ends immediately and both players lose.
Otherwise, pick a point on the battlefield within a number of inches of Da Red Gobbo equal to the roll. That point must be as near as possible to the exit point. Remove Da Red Gobbo from the battlefield and set him up again as near as possible to that point and more than 1" from all terrain features. If you are the underdog, set him up again within 6" of that point and more than 1" from all terrain features instead.

abilities.name: MAGNIFICENT MONSTROSITY
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect. If any enemy units are contesting Da Red Gobbo, you can add or subtract 1 from the roll (to a minimum of 1).
1
…Da Green Button?: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each unit’s melee weapons (friendly and enemy) for the rest of the turn.
2
…Da Blue Button?: Each player can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll or 1 random characteristic roll for a weapon’s Damage characteristic this turn.
3
…Da Yellow Button?: Each player gains 1 command point.
4
…Da Orange Button?: Each unit (friendly and enemy) on the battlefield has a Move characteristic of 3D6" for the rest of the turn.
5
…Da Purple Button?: Units (friendly and enemy) are not visible to other units outside their combat range for the rest of the turn.
6
…Da Red Button?: You must immediately use the ‘Clank, Clank, Clank’ ability as if it were the end of your turn.
7+
…Da Whirly Button?: Pick an enemy unit within 18" of Da Red Gobbo. Remove that unit from the battlefield. Then your opponent picks a point on the battlefield. Set up that enemy unit within 1" of that point and more than 9" from all enemy units. Each model in that enemy unit that cannot be set up in this way is automatically slain.

abilities.name: SITE OF SLAUGHTER
abilities.effect: Pick an objective wholly outside friendly territory. That objective is considered by you to be the amphitheatre.

abilities.name: FINISHING MOVES
abilities.effect:
While each model in a unit in this Regiment of Renown is contesting the amphitheatre:
That unit’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal).
If you control the amphitheatre, if the unmodified hit roll or wound roll for an attack that targets that unit is a 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

warscrolls.name: High Gladiatrix
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Coven Matriarch.

abilities.name: PARAGON OF SLAUGHTER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
If this unit is in combat, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
If this unit is not in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: DANCE OF DEATH
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: BROADMOORE AND LOUSE
abilities.effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Crew’s Leadshotters. In addition, if this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, you can set up a Freeguild Marshal and Relic Envoy wholly within 6" of this unit and not in combat. That unit has the IRON MARCH keyword.

abilities.name: BATTLE-PRIEST SOLANTRA WHYL
abilities.effect: This unit has PRIEST (1).

abilities.name: MASTER SAPPER GAVELOCK FISKE
abilities.effect: This unit’s ranged weapons have Anti-FACTION TERRAIN (+1 Rend) and Anti-WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend).

abilities.name: THE CHANT OF IRON
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly IRON MARCH PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick either a visible enemy unit within 18" of them or a visible friendly IRON MARCH unit that is wholly within 12" of them and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect:
If you picked an enemy unit:
If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible enemy unit to be a second target.
Subtract 2" from each target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.
If you picked a friendly unit, Heal (D3) the target and the chanter. If the chanting roll was 8+, Heal (D3) each visible friendly IRON MARCH unit that is wholly 12" of the chanter and that has not been healed by this ability this turn instead.

abilities.name: FORM UP, IRON MARCH!
abilities.declare:
Pick a friendly IRON MARCH unit to use this ability, then pick either 1 or 2 other visible friendly IRON MARCH units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.
The unit using this ability and the targets:
cannot be under orders.
must each be a different unit type.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are under orders.
Designer’s Note: ‘Unit type’ refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. ‘Cannonade Cogfort’ or ‘Mallus Forgepriest’.

abilities.name: ENGINEER BARTEL HOLST
abilities.effect: This unit has WARD (6+) and STRIKE-LAST.

abilities.name: ENGINEER GURREN ASHBROW
abilities.effect: Each time this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

abilities.name: ENGINEER KIRSTA LOUDREN
abilities.effect: If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice for each visible unit (friendly and enemy) within its combat range. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: CASTELLAN-CAPTAIN VYAN PHILSIN
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly IRON MARCH INFANTRY units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders.

abilities.name: COMMODORE DE GRAÇON
abilities.effect: This unit and up to 1 other friendly IRON MARCH WAR MACHINE within this unit’s combat range can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

abilities.name: CASTELLAN-CAPTAIN REGAN VANDERCLOUD
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
The target has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: INCUBATION PERIOD
abilities.declare: This ability must be used to deploy this Regiment of Renown.
abilities.effect: Set up the units in this Regiment of Renown in reserve festering within. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: BURSTING WITH LIFE
abilities.effect: If a friendly non-NURGLE’S GIFT unit would be destroyed, before the last model is removed from play, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll for each other friendly non-NURGLE’S GIFT unit that has been destroyed this battle. On a 5+, pick a friendly unit that is festering within and set it up wholly within 6" of that model. It can be set up in combat.

abilities.name: ENDLESS SWARM
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it has been destroyed.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit wholly within 6" of a friendly Feculent Gnarlmaw and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: BEAST
abilities.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: ROLLING ASH-CLOUDS
abilities.effect:
While the ash-clouds are low-lying:
Units, terrain features and MANIFESTATIONS cannot be set up in neutral territory.
Units, terrain features and MANIFESTATIONS cannot end a move within neutral territory unless they started that move wholly within neutral territory.
Models, terrain features and MANIFESTATIONS are not visible to other models more than 3" away unless a straight line can be drawn between any points on their bases that does not cross neutral territory.

abilities.name: IN THE SHADOW OF THE ETHERSEA
abilities.declare: This ability must be used to deploy this Regiment of Renown instead of the ‘Deploy Unit’ ability or the ‘Deploy Regiment’ ability.
abilities.effect: Set up the units in this Regiment of Renown in reserve in the ethersea. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: LAUNCH THE ATTACK
abilities.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown that is in the ethersea.
abilities.effect: Set up each unit on the battlefield wholly within 7" of a battlefield edge, more than 9" from all enemy units and within the combat range of another unit in this Regiment of Renown. Then, each unit can immediately move D3". The units cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: STRIKE ON THE MOVE
abilities.effect: This unit can use SHOOT abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: SWEEPING BLOWS
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit.
abilities.effect: If any damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that FIGHT ability are allocated to any enemy units, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by those enemy units for the rest of the turn.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit.

warscrolls.name: Akhelian Thrallmaster
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as an Akhelian Raidmaster.

abilities.name: AKHELIAN INSIGHTS
abilities.effect: Melee weapons used by friendly NAMARTI units have Crit (2 Hits) while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: THRALLMASTER
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly Namarti Thralls unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit

abilities.name: HUNT OF THE BLOODTHIRSTY SHIVER
abilities.effect:
If both units in this Regiment of Renown are within each other’s combat range, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:
Evasive Approach: While both units in this Regiment of Renown are within each other’s combat range, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target them.
Ferocious Attack: While both units in this Regiment of Renown are within each other’s combat range, their Allopex’s Ferocious Bites have Crit (2 Hits).

abilities.name: ENSNARED
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy MONSTER or CAVALRY unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

abilities.name: BLOODTHIRSTY PREDATORS
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Allopex’s Ferocious Bite while it is within 6" of any damaged enemy units or while it is within 6" of any enemy units that had any models slain in the same turn.

abilities.name: WHAT’S YOURS IS MINE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with a unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the target. Then, pick an artefact of power the target has.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll for each unit in this Regiment of Renown that is in combat with the target. On a 6+, the target no longer has that artefact of power.

abilities.name: SWOOP IN
abilities.declare: Pick the Grundstok Gunhauler in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability if it is studying the battlefield.
abilities.effect: Set up the Grundstok Gunhauler on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units that have an artefact of power and more than 9" from all other enemy units. Then, set up all other units in this Regiment of Renown wholly within 3" of the Grundstok Gunhauler and more than 6" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: AN EYE FOR LOOT
abilities.declare: This ability must be used to deploy this Regiment of Renown.
abilities.effect: Set up the units in this Regiment of Renown in reserve studying the battlefield. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: LIGHT BOMB RACKS
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that does not have FLY and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 4 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: AETHERSHOT OVERWATCH
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: LONG-LINE SLINGS
abilities.effect: When you use the ‘Transport Skyfarers’ ability for this unit, you can pick units in combat to be targets.

abilities.name: TRANSPORT CAPACITY
abilities.effect: This unit can transport 1 friendly KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY unit with a model count of up to 5 (see Battle Traits).

warscrolls.name: Endrinmaster with Dirigible Suit
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Guild Officer.

abilities.name: COMBAT ENGINEERS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly Endrinriggers unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, combat attacks made by the targets against enemy units that charged this turn have Crit (2 Hits).

abilities.name: MOBILE REPAIRS
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SKYVESSEL or Zontari Endrin Dock within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, Heal (3) the target.

abilities.name: TIMED CHARGES
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
This unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

abilities.name: SUPPLIES DONT COME CHEAP
abilities.declare: Pick a visible terrain feature within 18" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown. Each friendly unit wholly within 3" of that terrain feature is a target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, Heal (X) the target, where X is an amount equal to the roll.

abilities.name: NO ONE RIDES FOR FREE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly INFANTRY unit with up to 10 models that is wholly within 9" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown and not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield, then set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: LONG-RANGE SUPPORT
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within 15" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown and that no friendly units are contesting. Each unit contesting that objective is a target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: SPECIALIST GRUNDSTOK AMMUNITION
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase, Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit
abilities.declare: Pick Shieldbreaker ammunition or Thunderdrakk ammunition.
abilities.effect:
If all of the attacks made for that SHOOT ability target the same enemy unit, after that SHOOT ability has been resolved, roll a dice and add the number of damage points allocated to the target by that SHOOT ability. If the roll is higher than the target’s Control characteristic, apply the following effect to the target based on the ammunition type picked:
Shieldbreaker: Ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn.
Thunderdrakk: That target has a maximum control score of 1 until the start of your next turn.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit

warscrolls.name: Codewright
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Guild Officer.

abilities.name: ADVISORY ROLE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly SKYFARERS units to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to that target for the rest of the turn:
Seek New Prospects: Add 5 to the target’s control score.
Don’t Argue with the Wind: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target.
There’s No Trading With Some People: The target can use a RETREAT ability and still use SHOOT abilities later in the turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the target by RETREAT abilities.

abilities.name: UNSTOPPABLE BATTLE FURY
abilities.effect: This unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: ‘I’LL GET THERE MYSELF!’
abilities.effect: This unit cannot be set up in reserve and cannot be targeted by abilities that would remove it from the battlefield.

abilities.name: GRAPPLE-NET LAUNCHER

abilities.name: TAKE AIM!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is under orders to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of that unit’s ranged weapons. Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made with that weapon for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: FORM UP!
abilities.declare:
Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit to use this ability, then pick 2 other visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.
The unit using this ability and the targets:
cannot be under orders.
must each be a different unit type.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are under orders.
Designer’s Note: ‘Unit type’ refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. ‘Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal’ or ‘Cannonade Cogfort’.

abilities.name: JUSTICE WILL BE SERVED
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick the Neave Blacktalon in this Regiment of Renown to be the target if it is in combat with an enemy HERO.
abilities.effect: The target can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. Each time it does so, if it is in combat with an enemy HERO, all of its attacks must target an enemy HERO. In addition, after the first FIGHT ability is used, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

warscrolls.name: Lorai, Child of the Abyss
notes: This unit can only be taken in Neave Blacktalon’s regiment.

abilities.name: NEBULOUS SEA-FOG
abilities.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while a friendly THE BLACKTALONS unit is wholly within 6" of this unit, if the unmodified hit roll for a shooting attack that targets that unit is 1-5, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

abilities.name: AQUATIC ILLUSIONS
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: JUSTICE FROM AZYR
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s Whirlwind Axes for attacks that target a HERO.

abilities.name: VANGUARD CHAMBER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: WINDRIDER
abilities.declare: If this unit is in combat or charged this turn, this unit can make a pile-in move. Then, if this unit is in combat, you must pick 1 or more enemy units to be the target(s) of this unit’s attacks.
abilities.effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s). Then, roll a dice. On a 3+, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 3" from all enemy units and wholly within the combat range of a friendly THE BLACKTALONS unit that is not in combat.

warscrolls.name: Neave’s Companions
notes: This unit can only be taken in Neave Blacktalon’s regiment. This unit cannot be reinforced.

abilities.name: SHIELD OF AZYR
abilities.effect: While any friendly THE BLACKTALONS HEROES are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have WARD (5+).

abilities.name: THE SPHERE CELESTIAL
abilities.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a point on the battlefield within 1" of this unit and more than 3" from all other units (friendly and enemy) and terrain features to be the target point. Then, pick another visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR INFANTRY or CAVALRY HERO that is wholly within 18" of this unit and not in combat to be the target unit.
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target unit and not in combat. Then, remove the target unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target point and not in combat. This unit and the target unit can use MOVE abilities in the following movement phase (this is an exception to Core Rules, 24.0).

abilities.name: THE LAST BLADE OF EMBERGARD
abilities.effect: This unit can use this ability while it is in reserve. Pick 1 of this unit’s non-Companion melee weapons. Add 2 to that weapon’s Attacks characteristic and Rend characteristic for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: BONES OF SAINT IGNIFUS
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a SPELL or PRAYER ability for a visible unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the casting roll or chanting roll for that ability.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a SPELL or PRAYER ability for a visible unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders

abilities.name: EMERGENCY BELLOWS
abilities.effect: Remove 1 of this unit’s heat tokens.

abilities.name: NAVIGATE THE TUNNELS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 6" of a terrain feature that has a hidden passage token to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of a different terrain feature that has a hidden passage token and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SHIFTING PASSAGES
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick 2 non-FACTION TERRAIN terrain features to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Remove all hidden passage tokens from the battlefield (if any). Then, give each target a hidden passage token.

abilities.name: TWIN-TAILED COMET OF HONOUR
abilities.effect: While this unit has any champions, add 5 to this unit’s control score.

abilities.name: SUMMON UMBRAL SPELLPORTAL
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Umbral Spellportal on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an Umbral Spellportal wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. An Umbral Spellportal has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: SUMMON GEMINIDS OF UHL-GYSH
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: SUMMON PRISMATIC PALISADE
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Prismatic Palisade on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Prismatic Palisade wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: COLLECT THE TITHE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick the GOTHIZZAR HARVESTER in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability, then pick a NON-HERO INFANTRY unit (friendly or enemy) within its combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain, then give the unit using this ability 1 bone-tithe point.

abilities.name: SOUL TAX
abilities.declare:
Pick the Mortisan Ossifector in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, then:
Pick a friendly unit, excluding units in this Regiment of Renown, to be the target.
Pick a unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the recipient.
The target and the recipient must be wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
The target has a maximum control score of 1.
Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for the recipient’s combat attacks.

abilities.name: REBUILD ON THE MARCH
abilities.declare: Pick the Gothizzar Harvester in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability if it has 6 bone-tithe points. Then, pick another unit in this Regiment of Renown that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Reset the Gothizzar Harvester’s bone-tithe points to 0. Then, set up a replacement of the target unit with half the number of models (rounding up) wholly within 9" of the Gothizzar Harvester and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SHIELDS OF THE LEGION
abilities.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability that targeted a visible OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit within this unit’s combat range
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks made as part of that Attack ability that target any friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS units within this unit’s combat range.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability that targeted a visible OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit within this unit’s combat range

abilities.name: BONE CAGE
abilities.effect: This unit is either full or empty. It starts the battle full.

abilities.name: BONE HARVEST
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each enemy unit that has been destroyed this battle. Add 1 to each roll if this unit used a FIGHT ability this turn. If any of the rolls are a 4+, this unit is full.

abilities.name: REPAIR CONSTRUCT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is full, pick a visible friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Return 1 slain model to the target unit. If the target has a Health characteristic of 1 return 3 slain models to it instead. Then, this unit is empty.

warscrolls.name: Mortisan Ossifector
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Mortisan Vizier.

abilities.name: REFINED CREATIONS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Mortek Crawler, Gothizzar Harvester, Morghast Archai or Morghast Harbingers unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s weapons until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: SUMMON HORRORGHAST
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Horrorghast on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Horrorghast wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON SOULSCREAM BRIDGE
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulscream Bridge on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Soulscream Bridge wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulscream Bridge has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: SUMMON LAUCHON THE SOULSEEKER
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Lauchon the Soulseeker on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Lauchon the Soulseeker wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON SHARDS OF VALAGHARR
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Shards of Valagharr endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Shards of Valagharr endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Shards of Valagharr endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: CYCLE MANIFESTATION
abilities.declare:
Pick the Scinari Calligrave in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly MANIFESTATIONS below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Sanctum of Amyntok
Hyshian Twinstones
Rune of Petrification
abilities.effect: If there is already a friendly MANIFESTATION from the list above on the battlefield, it is immediately banished and removed from play. Then, set up the MANIFESTATION you picked within 1" of the caster and visible to them. If that MANIFESTATION is a Sanctum of Amyntok, it must instead be set up wholly within 12" of the caster, more than 3" from all enemy units, and with its 3 parts touching each other so that they form a ring.

abilities.name: ARCANE TAXONOMY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Remove the Scinari Calligrave in this Regiment of Renown from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 3" of a friendly MANIFESTATION and more than 7" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SWIFT ERASURE
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each friendly unit that was picked to be a target of that SPELL ability and that is wholly within 12" of the Scinari Calligrave in this Regiment of Renown. On a 4+, that SPELL ability has no effect on that unit.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared a SPELL ability

warscrolls.name: Scinari Calligrave
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Lumineth Paragon.

abilities.name: REALMSCRIBE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You declared the ‘Depict Rune’ ability
abilities.effect:
Replace 1 instance of a rune on your battle scripture with 1 of the following:
Varinor, Rune of Strength
Ydriliqi, Rune of the River
Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain
Oreali, Rune of the Wind

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared the ‘Depict Rune’ ability

abilities.name: TURN TO STONE
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 6" of this MANIFESTATION. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. If an enemy unit has at least 3 mortal damage inflicted on it by this ability this turn, it has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: RESERVOIR OF POWER
abilities.effect:
Each time a unit (friendly or enemy) successfully casts a spell while it is within 12" of this MANIFESTATION, give this MANIFESTATION 1 arcane charge point.
This MANIFESTATION can have a maximum of 6 arcane charge points.

abilities.name: RELEASE ARCANE CHARGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a SPELL or UNBIND ability for a LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD within 3" of this MANIFESTATION
abilities.effect: Add this MANIFESTATION arcane charge points to the casting roll or unbinding roll. Then, reset this MANIFESTATION's arcane charge points to 0.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a SPELL or UNBIND ability for a LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD within 3" of this MANIFESTATION

abilities.name: MULTIPLE PARTS
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this MANIFESTATION’s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this MANIFESTATION is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play

abilities.name: SIGIL OF YNGRA
abilities.effect:
While a friendly unit with a Health characteristic of 10 or less is wholly inside the ring formed by this MANIFESTATION:
That unit is not visible to enemy units that are not within its combat range.
Enemy abilities that would target that unit must target this MANIFESTATION instead.

abilities.name: SEARCH THE RUIN
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that does not have an emberstone nugget and is contesting a Sun Seekers objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Give the target an emberstone nugget. If you are the underdog, the target can immediately move 6" but cannot end that move in combat. The target cannot use the ‘Back to Base Camp’ or ‘Power Through’ ability for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: BACK TO BASE CAMP
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has an emberstone nugget, was not set up this turn and is contesting a Golden Lions objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target’s emberstone nugget.

abilities.name: EMBERSTONE CACHE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit contesting an objective you control to be the target.
abilities.effect: Give the target an emberstone sliver.

abilities.name: EMBERSTONE-AUGMENTED WEAPONS
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn and has any emberstone slivers to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:
Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
Then, if you are the underdog, remove all of the target’s emberstone slivers. Otherwise, remove all emberstone slivers from each friendly unit.

abilities.name: ALL THE RAGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick a pair of objectives to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle round, the target is the coveted pair of objectives instead of the other pair of objectives.

abilities.name: ARCANE CHARGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick a Place of Power you control to be the target.
abilities.effect: Draw a straight line from the centre of the primary objective to the target. If that line crosses any secondary objectives, the first secondary objective that the line crosses is now the primary objective and all other objectives are now secondary objectives.

abilities.name: TOE TO TOE
abilities.effect: Subtract 10 from the control scores of enemy MONSTERS while they are in combat with any units in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: GRIMNIR’S DEFIANCE
abilities.effect: Units in this Regiment of Renown cannot be picked to be the target of RAMPAGE abilities used by enemy units.

abilities.name: DUTY UNTO DEATH
abilities.effect: While any friendly FYRESLAYERS INFANTRY HEROES are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have WARD (5+).

abilities.name: SMOULDERING BRAZIERS
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: WHIRLWIND OF DESTRUCTION
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons if this unit charged this turn.

warscrolls.name: Grimhold Exile
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as Grimnir’s Chosen.

abilities.name: LAST OF THE LODGE-FIRE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target’s Health characteristic. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: HONOUR TO GRIMNIR!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly FYRESLAYERS INFANTRY units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for the targets for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: MOLTEN ROCKBOLTS
abilities.effect: Each time a shooting attack made by this unit scores a critical hit, subtract 1" from the target unit’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn. This ability cannot reduce the target unit’s unmodified Move characteristic below half.

abilities.name: SUMMON BURNING HEAD
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly The Burning Head on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up The Burning Head wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON EMERALD LIFESWARM
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Emerald Lifeswarm on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an Emerald Lifeswarm wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON RAVENAK’S GNASHING JAWS
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Ravenak’s Gnashing Jaws endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Ravenak’s Gnashing Jaws endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
